descriptions.zh: 吞食恒星的怪物被击杀了，它的尸体依然散发着最近被它所吞噬的恒星的能源。对它进行解剖也许能够让我们揭秘它是如何消化宇宙中最热的物体的。
descriptions.en: The star consumer has been slain, its body still radiating the energy from the star it last fed on. Studying it might reveal the secrets of how it is capable of digesting the warmest objects in the universe.

descriptions.zh: 彻底研究过这个噬星者后，我们找到了一个方法可以将被吞噬的恒星恢复成初始形态，让这个陷入了寒冬的恒星系重新感受到恒星的温暖。
descriptions.en: After having studied the stellar devourer we've found a way to maybe return the consumed star mass to its point of origin, restoring the warmth to the system now stuck in an eternal winter.

descriptions.zh: 我们最近在[guardians_horror_system.GetName]星系附近驱逐的敌对个体使用了某种强大的维度裂隙连接了我们的世界和他们的扭曲国度。在最大的位面裂隙我们观测到了异常的能量读数。我们应该更接近地去研究这些异常读数。
descriptions.en: The malevolent entity that we recently banished near [guardians_horror_system.GetName] used some kind of powerful dimensional rifts to bridge the gap between our world and its own twisted realm. Anomalous energy readings have been detected where the largest rift was opened. We would do well to study these readings more closely.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName]星系所击败的巨无霸无畏舰基本上完好无损。虽然需要庞大数量的资源来修复它，但是一旦修复成功我们的舰队就能如虎添翼。
descriptions.en: The hull of the massive dreadnought that we disabled in the [guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName] system is largely intact. Though it will require an enormous amount of resources, we should be able to repair the warship and press it into service with our own fleet.

descriptions.zh: 我们的部队成功破坏了[hive_system.GetName]星系的其中一个蜂巢小行星。我们最好派出一支科研队前往探索该小行星的内部。
descriptions.en: Our forces have managed to pacify one of the hive asteroids in the [hive_system.GetName] system. We should dispatch a science team to explore the asteroid's interior.

descriptions.zh: 我们与[hiver_system.GetName]小行星中的生物在生理学上颇为相似。他们和我们一样能在真空中茁壮生长。若将我们的意志加至其上他们会变为非常有用的工具。
descriptions.en: We appear to be physiologically quite similar to the creatures inside the asteroids of [hiver_system.GetName]. Just like us, they thrive in the vacuum of space. If we exert our will upon them they could become a useful instrument.

descriptions.zh: 派一支拆除专家小组登陆堡垒的侧面尝试炸开气闸。
descriptions.en: Send a squad of demolition experts to land on the side of the fortress and attempt to blast the airlock open.

descriptions.zh: 派出一支科研船提供局部能源，尝试将能源局限于堡垒的气闸部分。
descriptions.en: Send a science ship supplying energy locally, attempting to restrict power to the portion of the fortress that powers the airlock.

descriptions.zh: 或许对黑洞的运作原理的研究可以帮助我们了解堡垒中的暗物质是如何被利用的。
descriptions.en: Perhaps the answers to how dark matter is used in the fortress can be found in the workings of a black hole.

descriptions.zh: 研究附近的恒星也许能够让我们找到一些关于这座堡垒建造过程的线索。
descriptions.en: Studying the local star might give some insight into the conditions the builders of the fortress started their work in.

descriptions.zh: 如果能够将我们自己拥有的暗物质提供给堡垒的核心，也许能够让堡垒系统误以为自己已经在运行，从而停止输送。
descriptions.en: If we provide our own supply of dark matter to the heart of the fortress, we might be able to trick the system that it is already running and stop the flow.

descriptions.zh: 我们的团队成功通过某处被遗弃的管道打开了一条通往堡垒核心的通道。对着核心发射一枚鱼雷也许可以阻止它重启。
descriptions.en: Our team has managed to open up a passage to the core through an empty duct. Firing a torpedo into the core might stop it from restarting.

descriptions.zh: 我们现在可以安全地研究环绕着卡冈都亚黑洞旋转的那个金属球体了。不知道在它的核心处能够发现些什么呢？
descriptions.en: The metallic orb hovering around the Gargantua black hole is now open for study. What will we find once we reach its processing center?

descriptions.zh:
我们需要辅助无限神机扫描卡冈都亚黑洞。虽说想要从黑洞中获取信息是不可能的，但是无限神机却似乎拥有某种查看黑洞的引力数据并回收这些数据的方法。只不过这个过程会§Y非常§!耗时。

我们需要做的就是把运算能力借给它使用，以期稍微减短这段漫长过程。
descriptions.en:
In order to assist the Infinity Machine, we need to aid it in its scans of the black hole Gargantua. Receiving information from a black hole is impossible, but the Infinity Machine appears to have a method of accessing its gravitational data and getting information out of it. It simply takes a §Yvery§! long time.

We only need to lend it our processing power, easing its computational burden by a tiny fraction.

descriptions.zh: 骇入这个金属球体的核心程序也许能让我们进一步了解它到底是什么，以及它正在做什么事情。
descriptions.en: Hacking into the metallic sphere's central programming might yield some further insight into what it is and what it is doing.

descriptions.zh: 派一队拆除专家应该就可以发现这个神秘球形外壳的结构弱点，并借此终结这个无声的威胁。
descriptions.en: A team of demolitions experts should be able to identify and exploit points of failure in the integrity of the mysterious sphere's hull, ending the silent menace.

descriptions.zh:
这颗在龙巢中发现的蛋仍然显示出微弱的生命迹象。我们的科学家认为，模拟龙蛋的孵化环境并最终成功孵化是可行的。然而，我们就算成功孵化了龙蛋，得到的以太龙几乎不可能拥有与其先祖相同的大小和力量，但是如果我们对其进行合理的驯养，这仍然会是我们不可估量资产。

这颗龙蛋脱离了龙巢不能存活太久，我们必须加快行动了。
descriptions.en:
The egg recovered from the Dragon's Hoard still shows faint signs of life. It should be possible to deduce and emulate an ideal incubation environment for the egg, with the goal of eventually hatching it. Should we be successful in hatching the egg, the resulting Ether Drake is unlikely to match its ancestors in size or power, but with proper domestication will undoubtedly prove to be an incredible asset.

The egg will not last long outside of the environment it was found in. We must act quickly.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetNecromancersLower]相信他们能够用一些仪式与科技结合的手段让§Y以太龙§!再吐龙息，比如从当地恒星收集等离子体、向巨龙尸体中加装寄生引擎等等诸如此类的手段。
descriptions.en: Our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] believe that they can reignite the spark within the §YEther Drake§! through a blend of ritual and science: gathering plasma from the local star, attaching cordyceptic engines to the corpse, and so on.

descriptions.zh: 虽然[dragon_system.GetName]恒星系的龙被击杀了，但我们的[Owner.GetNecromancersLower]向我们保证，这种事态不会持续太久。他们承诺，他们很快就可以复活它——并且安全地成为我们的奴仆——很快。
descriptions.en: Though the dragon of the [dragon_system.GetName] system has been slain, our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] assure us that this state of affairs need not last long. They promise that they can revive it - safely in thralldom to us - in short order.

titles.zh: 找到噬星者寄生的解决方案。
titles.en: Find a Cure for the Stellar Devourer Infestation

descriptions.zh: §Y[This.GetName]§!受到噬星者的寄生。我们不确定它们从何而来，只知道必须尽快移除它们，否则星系内的所有生命都将在劫难逃。
descriptions.en: §Y[This.GetName]§! has become infested with Stellar Devourers. We are unsure where they came from, but they need to be removed soon or else all life in the system might be at an end.
